name: 25953-longchat-kimilinear48b-tp4
model: moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct, bf16, UNQUANTIZED. ~49 B parameters, ~3 B active per token, ~96 GB of weights, ~24 GB per card at TP4. Ungated on HF and already in this machine's cache.
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, NVLink, four cards of one a3 node. No router, no external cache tier, no second node.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1. No expert parallelism, no speculative decoding, no context parallelism, no disaggregation.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 300 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, streaming, no shared prefix, driven at `/v1/chat/completions`: 80000 prompt tokens fixed with no spread, 64 output tokens pinned (`output_tokens_min == output_tokens_max == 64`, `ignore_eos: true`), `temperature: 0.0`, seed 42.
purpose: A long-document analysis assistant summarizing 80,000-token submissions into brief answers, one request at a time, on four GPUs.
launch:
# The launch config, in `sglang serve` CLI form.
# FLAT PARSER: one `key: value` per line. A nested block is DROPPED silently, so a structured
# value must stay on one line. Every key below is a real ServerArgs field at the pinned commit.

model-path: moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct

# ~96 GB of bf16 weights forces TP>=2; four rather than two so the 80k prefill completes faster
# and so there is room for the request-to-token table the checkpoint's 1048576 context forces.
tp-size: 4

# Required: the checkpoint loads its tokenizer from remote code and will not start without this.
trust-remote-code: true

random-seed: 42

# Everything else is a stock default of the pinned commit and nothing is tuned:
# mem-fraction-static, context-length, max-prefill-tokens, chunked-prefill-size,
# max-running-requests, cuda-graph-max-bs, attention-backend, page-size, dtype, quantization,
# chat-template (the checkpoint's own template is what is served -- do not pass one).
# If the server will not start, --mem-fraction-static is the one lever, downward, in steps.
# host / port / served-model-name belong to whoever starts the server.
